contributions.detail: One row, 300,00, = the Form A printed TOTAL 300.00 = cover line 1 CUMULATIVE. This cover is fully filled: LAST 300.00 + THIS slashed-zero (=0) = CUMULATIVE 300.00, and that arithmetic is itself the proof that the schedule is the CYCLE-TO-DATE ledger rather than this period's activity - the row is dated 2020-04-08, months before this report's certified period 10/27/2020-12/15/2020, and the THIS-report column says the period saw nothing. Line 2 (the sub-$50 aggregate) is a slashed zero in all three columns and is never itemized.

expenditures.detail: DELTA of +0.30, identical to the June filing (key 703ce1ad) because pages 2-3 here are a photocopy of that filing's schedules. Rows sum 1195.91; the printed TOTAL, cover line 3 LAST and cover line 3 CUMULATIVE all read 1,195.61, and the cover chain closes on it exactly (300.00 - 1195.61 = -895.61). The two candidate cells are again row 3 '.87' and row 4 '.88'; this is a SEPARATE SCAN of the same ink and was re-read at 600 dpi with a 4x upscale - it reads identically, which is correlated evidence and settles nothing. Rows published verbatim, unadjusted, needs_review=1 on every row of the side.

gates.balance_chain: Closes exactly, and the cross-filing chain RUNS (two filings by one filer in one cycle inside this chunk): this cover's 'Totals from LAST Report' column (300.00 / Ø / 1,195.61 / -895.61) reproduces the June filing 703ce1ad's figures verbatim; its THIS column is a slashed zero on all four lines; its CUMULATIVE column is 300.00 / Ø / 1,195.61 / -895.61. LAST + THIS = CUMULATIVE holds on every line. No swapped-cover signature.

notes: Generation 2 form. Chunk file / index.csv say Gary L. Christensen, Recorder, 2020; the cover's name and Office ('Recorder') AGREE. Certified period 10/27/2020-12/15/2020, signed and dated 12/15/2020 (the filename and the module's filing_date say 12-16-2020 - the signature is the 15th; noted, not corrected). PHOTOCOPIED SCHEDULES: pages 2 and 3 are the same physical Form A and Form B sheets as key 703ce1ad in this chunk, re-copied under a new cover - identical ink, identical placement, identical five expenditure rows and one contribution row, all dated March-April 2020, i.e. months before this report's period. Per the addendum that is the evidence that the LEDGER is cycle-to-date while the COVERS are per-period, and this cover's own LAST + THIS = CUMULATIVE arithmetic confirms it. Both filings were transcribed in full; neither was skipped as a duplicate. A stray '$' is written in front of the cumulative contribution figure ('$300,00'), recorded verbatim in the anchor. Candidate's home street address, city, ZIP, home phone and business phone are printed in the clear on the cover and were discarded at read time.
